verdict.rationale: Pulumi ships an official MCP server (verified via a live handshake) that lets external AI coding assistants like Claude Code/Cursor query Pulumi resources and generate infrastructure code, and Neo lets users describe infra changes in plain English, but these are separate integrations/products rather than a natively built-in NL-to-IaC generator, and community feedback flags Pulumi's genAI-based docs/assistance as weak in practice.
